pages.title: Useful Nonmetal Ores
pages.text: Sulfur Ore, Phosphorite Ore, Potash Ore, and Tar Ore supply workshop materials beyond metal ingots. Furnace and Crusher recipes turn them into their useful products.
Sulfur Dust, Phosphorus, Potash, Tar, and Bitumen have different crafting and processing roles. Use Recipes and Uses in an installed recipe viewer before committing a large supply to one route.
